name: Alex Rivera

summaries.default: Platform engineer building dependable services, practical automation, and clear operating documentation for small engineering teams.
summaries.platform: Platform engineer focused on dependable service delivery, repeatable infrastructure, and practical developer tooling. Connects operational experience with automation and clear team playbooks.
summaries.observability: Platform engineer focused on service telemetry, actionable alerts, and incident learning. Builds instrumentation and operating playbooks that help teams understand production behavior.

projects.name: Beacon DNS
bullets: Built a DNS configuration validator with previewable changes and repeatable local checks before service rollout.
Documented recovery procedures and test fixtures for malformed records, timeouts, and configuration drift.

projects.name: PhotoSort
bullets: Created a local photo organizer with resumable processing, structured event logs, and a reviewable change manifest.
Added timing metrics and failure summaries to make large collection imports easier to diagnose.

bullets.text: Standardized service deployment templates with automated configuration checks and documented rollback procedures.
Introduced service telemetry reviews that connected alert thresholds to user impact and incident follow-up work.
Built a shared release checklist and rehearsed recovery workflows with application teams before major launches.
Mentored engineers through incident reviews and translated recurring operational questions into reusable runbooks.
Automated environment setup and validation so developers could reproduce service dependencies on local machines.
Instrumented background workers with structured logs and queue timing metrics for production troubleshooting.
Maintained service ownership records and paired with engineers to improve operational handoffs during releases.

education: Independent study in distributed systems, networking, and software engineering
certifications: Northwind Systems Internal Platform Readiness Certificate, 2024
